messages:
Morgan: deploy-bot aborted the prod promote — staging-runner pool flagged a cache integrity error on artifact ingestion. tagging @DevOps because this blocks the change window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Job 8974 FAILED: cache-checksum-mismatch for /artifacts/service-x/2026-03-23/sha256:abc123. Retries exhausted. (seen on runner-staging-{2,3})

DevOps: :eyes: Are we sure it's cache corruption and not transient network? any S3 5xx in the logs?

SRE-Jen: I pulled the logs from runner-staging-3 — object read succeeded but checksum computed by runner != manifest checksum. looks like partial upload on previous CI attempt.

Morgan: snippet:
```
2026-03-23T14:01:12Z downloader: GET s3://redwood-artifacts/service-x/sha256/abc123 -> 200
2026-03-23T14:01:12Z verifier: expected sha256=abc123 computed=abf123 (mismatch)
2026-03-23T14:01:12Z orchestrator: aborting promote, cache quarantine
```

Janet: This is during our 16:00 UTC change window. If we don't unblock soon we miss today's cut. Options: pin to last-good artifact, reupload artifact now, or rollback the canary to previous deploy. Thoughts?

Patrick: We can quickly reupload the artifact from the build cache (we have the last-good tarball on build-node-7). That will cause a new object with same contents but new digest — will that break promote? deploy-bot expects manifest digest equality.

DevOps: Good point. If we upload a new object the manifest will change and the promote will require a new manifest update. Pinning to the last-good release tag (v1.12.4) in the deploy config would be fastest.

SRE-Jen: Pinning is safest short-term. It avoids touching the artifact store. Then we can investigate the corrupt object and reupload with a proper manifest. Risk: the pinned version misses the last bugfix in v1.12.5 — is that acceptable for today?

Morgan: The bugfix in v1.12.5 is cosmetic (logging), not security. Ops and PM already green for pin if it unblocks. I'll put a small release-note blurb about deferring v1.12.5.

Janet: Agree to pin. Action items: Morgan to patch promote config to v1.12.4 and re-run deploy-bot. SRE-Jen to open an incident for artifact checksum mismatch and mark object abc123 quarantined. DevOps to prepare step-by-step for reupload if needed.

Morgan: Doing it now — will update when deploy-bot re-triggers.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Manual pin requested by Morgan. Promote job queued for v1.12.4. Expect smoke in ~3m.

Patrick: FYI I'll snapshot build-node-7 artifact and upload to s3 to have a clean copy for later reconciliation.

SRE-Jen: Noted — I'll correlate object abc123 to older ingestion records. tagging this as P2 incident (investigate and repair) so it doesn't hold cuts.

Morgan: Deploy-bot smoke passed on v1.12.4. promote completed. I'm adding a line to the release notes: "Promote paused due to artifact checksum mismatch; rolled back to last-known-good v1.12.4 while we investigate object abc123." Will follow up with incident postmortem.

Janet: Thanks everyone. Good rollback/pin decision. :thumbsup:
